title: 30Astrella Del Mar Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Neighborhood deeded beach access; skip the crowded public access - Private pool, can be heated for additional fee during off-season - 2 Beach cruiser bikes included - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - Outdoor viewing tower - Private parking spaces - Fully stocked kitchen complete with Keurig and standard drip coffee maker - 2 KING suites with en-suite baths - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS -**Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($150 fee applies at booking). -Pool Heat available when pool is below 80 degrees, November-April. The cost is $50/day. Welcome to 30Astrella Del Mar centrally located along 30A with prime neighborhood deeded beach accesses and a private heated pool! 30Astrella Del Mar is a 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath house conveniently located on a short, quiet street with a 1 minute walk to the private, deeded beach access or a 2 minute walk to the fantastic Santa Clara public beach access. Multiple public beach accesses are within a 5 minute walk as well allowing you close proximity and easy access to the beach at your convenience. 30Astrella Del Mar comes with a fully equipped kitchen with updated appliances and a cozy coffee nook to meet your needs for meal prep and snacks. The open-concept living, dining, and kitchen areas on the main level allow plenty of room to settle in. On the second floor you will discover four generously sized bedrooms, including two primary suites, each featuring their own ensuite bathroom and smart TVs. For those seeking sunrises, sunsets, and breathtaking views the third level has a balcony to catch glimpses of the Emerald Coast. The backyard oasis has the perfect setting to relax outside with a private pool which can be heated, space to play yard games, or unwind under the beautiful oaks natural to Seagrove Beach. Want to explore all the unique towns along 30A? 30Astrella Del Mar offers a prime location along 30A to explore from Dune Allen to Rosemary Beach. Two beach cruiser bikes are included with your stay with the option to rent additional bikes. 30Astrella Del Mar presents an incredible opportunity to experience the best of 30A living. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR: Living Room with Cable and streaming apps, Updated Kitchen, Outdoor screened in porch overlooking the pool SECOND FLOOR: King Master Suite 1; TV with en-suite bath (shower/tub combo) King Master Suite 2; TV (shower/tub combo) Queen bedroom, TV Shared Hall Bath (shower/tub combo with separate room for sink) Bunk Room (sleeps 4 in all twin beds) Must be 25 to rent Sorry, no pets!
